feature.label: Cloud ALM Link for ADT
feature.description: Cloud ALM Link connects ABAP Development Tools (ADT) with SAP Cloud ALM: see the transports and Cloud ALM features of an ABAP object, open features from the Transport Organizer, and follow Cloud ALM IDs in source code comments.
